content.description: The Great Seal of the State of North Carolina is a black-and-white circular emblem featuring two female figures, Liberty and Plenty, standing on either side of a staff. Liberty holds a pole with a liberty cap, while Plenty sits beside a cornucopia. The seal includes the dates "MAY 20, 1775" and "APRIL 12, 1776," along with the Latin motto "ESSE QUAM VIDERI" at the bottom.
